datasets.title: British Virgin Islands Roads (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 735 km of roads in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 97 % of the total road length in the dataset region. The average age of data for the region is 3 years ( Last edited 4 months ago ) and 2% of roads were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['highway'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en highway surface smoothness width lanes oneway bridge layer source This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_vgb_roads]

lineage.description: Road network data extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information database, covering approximately 735 km of roads in the British Virgin Islands with attributes including highway type, surface material, width, and lanes. Data represents approximately 97% of total road length based on AI-mapped estimates, with average data age of 3 years.
